bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (2021 Measures No. 3) Bill 2021

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-05-27.23.9) "*that the words proposed to be omitted stand part of the question.*" In other words, they voted to keep the usual [second reading motion](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) unchanged. A second reading motion is "*that the bill be read a second time,*" which is parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill.
